item.title: Rallying Cry – November 7, 2026
item.description: A century-old secret in Van Gogh’s ‘Café Terrace at Night’ was finally uncovered, a former young offender became a junior doctor after sticking to his plan, and scientists found new hints of volcanic activity on Mars that could point to alien life.
